business: Maruti Suzuki manufactures and sells passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, and related services in India, exporting to ~120 countries. Market leader in Indian passenger vehicles and largest vehicle exporter.

segments.name: Passenger Vehicles
segments.comment: Market leader; hatchbacks, sedans, SUVs, MPVs across segments

segments.name: Commercial Vehicles
segments.comment: Super Carry mini trucks and Eeco Cargo delivery vans

segments.name: Support Services
segments.comment: Finance, insurance, parts, accessories, driving school

revenue_mix: Domestic-focused India sales with 47 lakh exports (FY'26) to 120 countries. Top five destinations: South Africa, Japan, Chile, Saudi Arabia, EU.
strategy: Expand capacity to 3.65M units by FY'31 via Kharkhoda, Hansalpur, Sanand
Launch BEVs, Strong Hybrids, CNG, Flex Fuel vehicles across portfolio
Increase exports targeting 50% of India's passenger vehicle share
Shift 28% of logistics to rail for costs and emissions
Strengthen premium Nexa channel for higher-margin models and segments
outlook: Car industry to reach 6.1-6.3M units by FY'31; small cars accelerating. CNG sales target 9L units. e VITARA EV gaining traction with 5,648 Q1 sales.
capex_plans: ₹35,000 crores investment at Sanand for 1M capacity. Targets: 2.9M by FY'27-end, 3.65M by FY'31-end.
risks: Global economic slowdown (Iran-US war impact affecting markets)
Supply constraints: 1.9L pending orders creating fulfillment pressure
Intense automotive competition pressuring market share and margins
EV adoption pace and charging infrastructure development risks
flags: Dividend ₹140/share (highest ever) approved. SMC owns 58.53%. Suzuki Motor Gujarat amalgamated. No auditor qualifications mentioned.
